cifar_gam_ewc.metric_definition: Final and AIA use last CNN top1 curve of completed 10 tasks; AIA is arithmetic mean of 10 rounded sample accuracies. Do not use JSON final.AAA, which has a different denominator. NaN upper-triangle/unavailable FWT/FG are undefined metrics, not training failure.
cifar_gam_ewc.fullmodel_evidence: Every listed output log initially reports All params = Trainable params = 85798656; factory.py maps the model to models_CL; EWCGAMProjected constructs IncrementalNet. cifar224 uses torchvision CIFAR100 in utils/data.py:591-592.

ewc_only.scope: Four located FullModel SGD + online normalized-Fisher EWC baseline configuration groups; not an exhaustive hyperparameter inventory. Sources read-only; no training.
ewc_only.metric_definition: CNN sample-weighted final accuracy; arithmetic mean of complete stage CNN top1 curves; across-seed sample standard deviation ddof=1. NaN training attempts excluded only from valid-subset statistics and retained explicitly.

identity_evidence.merge_note: This base EWCon_Probe learner has no trajectory weight-merge implementation; separate GAM/merge learners are distinct factory names. Current source supports log identity but is not immutable historical source attestation.
